messages:
morgan: Heads up — our scheduled priv-delta-scan just flagged unexpected role bindings on a customer Dedicated control plane. I'm seeing a `cluster-admin` binding granted to a platform service account for customer-123.

sec-bot: ALERT: role_binding delta detected (scan_id=priv-delta-20240520). Added binding: subject=system:serviceaccount:platform:platform-ci -> role=cluster-admin in cluster=dedicated-customer-123

asha: Ugh. Could be the CI runner creds rotated and got broader perms. @kevin can you triage logs?

kevin: On it. Pulling api-server audit logs for 2024-05-20 02:00-02:20 UTC.

eli: If that SA touched secrets or KMS, we need to check key usage. KMS access would escalate severity.

samir: Confirming environment: flagged cluster = dedicated, not private. Also check recent VPC allowlist PRs; there was a merge yesterday that touched the customer-123 rule.

morgan: Yep dedicated. PR #3421 modified allowlist entries and updated the infra role mapping for platform-ci. Pinging @devops to see if any CI side changes rolled out.

kevin: Found the audit entry showing the bind op. Snippet:
```json
{
  "verb": "create",
  "objectRef": { "resource": "rolebindings", "name": "platform-ci-cluster-admin" },
  "user": { "username": "system:serviceaccount:platform:platform-ci" },
  "responseStatus": { "code": 201 }
}
```

asha: That service account should only have `edit` in infra namespaces. Not cluster-admin. Sounds like a misapplied role or a templating bug.

sec-bot: Incident tagged: security-privilege-delta. Severity: P2 (pending KMS evidence) -> escalate to P1 if KMS decrypts or secret exfil.

audit-bot: Audit archive created: s3://redwood-infra-prod/audits/2024/05/20/1718812345-priv-delta-archive.tar.gz

eli: KMS logs show a `Decrypt` call at 2024-05-20T02:12:08Z by principal arn:aws:sts::111222333444:assumed-role/platform-ci/ci-runner. kms_request_id=abc-xyz-123.

morgan: If that matches the same SA, escalate to P1 and assume key compromise until proven otherwise. Action items: 1) revoke any active tokens for platform-ci in the dedicated control plane, 2) remove the errant `cluster-admin` RoleBinding, 3) rotate the KMS key if the SA used it.

samir: How do we revoke tokens for dedicated? I thought token lifetimes are short but the cluster uses our auth-service for token issuance.

kevin: I kicked off a token revocation job against auth-service: POST /admin/revoke?service=platform-ci (job_id=revok-17188). Also patched RBAC in staging, pushed PR: https://github.com/redwood-infra/infra/pull/3587 — patch removes the problematic binding and constrains platform-ci to `namespace:infra:edit`.

kevin: Commands I ran locally for emergency rollback:
```bash
# remove rolebinding
kubectl --context=dedicated-customer-123 -n kube-system delete rolebinding platform-ci-cluster-admin || true
# apply restricted binding
kubectl --context=dedicated-customer-123 -n infra apply -f restricted-platform-ci-binding.yaml
```

asha: After the RBAC change, running smoke tests now. Will post results in ~10m.

eli: I filed vuln triage ticket TICKET-431 (component: kms, priority: P1 if key access confirmed). Linking logs and audit archive.

morgan: Also loop in CS — if this was triggered by the allowlist PR, affected customers need a heads-up. @samir can you draft a short note? Keep it factual: detection, mitigation steps, no signs of exfil yet.

samir: On it. Drafted message and sending to PM/CS for review.

sec-bot: Note: remember to verify private control plane KMS policies as well — on-prem customers use different key policies and we must ensure no cross-tenant principals.

kevin: Follow-up: RBAC rollback merged to prod at 02:32 UTC, revocation job completed (job_id=revok-17188, affected_tokens=4). Smoke tests show no elevated perms remaining. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-infra/infra/pull/3587

morgan: Good. Next steps: eli to coordinate KMS rotation timeline if required; kevin to produce short postmortem; asha to validate CI job templates; samir to send customer comms.

eli: I'll wait 24h for additional anomalies then propose rotation window. If we find any decrypted secrets referenced externally, rotate immediately.

kevin: Postmortem draft started: https://docs.google.com/doc/d/pm-draft-priv-delta (will attach logs + timeline).

morgan: Thanks team. Keep updates here. Closing thread when KMS decision + postmortem are done. :thumbsup:
